title: Vancouver
subtitle: Rainy streets, North Shore water and a day above the snow line at Whistler.

cover.alt: A seaplane taxiing across Vancouver Harbour below cargo ships, the North Shore waterfront and cloud-wrapped mountains.
cover.caption: A seaplane taxiing across Vancouver Harbour below cargo ships, the North Shore waterfront and cloud-wrapped mountains.

chapters.title: Rain along the waterfront
paragraphs: Low clouds hang over the harbour. After dark, wet streets reflect the lamps and shop windows around Gastown.

chapters.title: Light across the harbour
paragraphs: Seaplanes cross the water below the North Shore mountains. Cargo ships, waterfront buildings and a goose on a roof fill the quieter views.

chapters.location: Lake and forest trails, Vancouver area

chapters.title: Snow and cloud at Whistler
paragraphs: Skiers move between the lifts and lodge in low cloud. Clearer openings reveal forested valleys, snowy ridges and gondolas above the slopes.
